{{Top}}
[[File:NBL.jpg|thumb|220px|Serv-O-Droid RICs outplay [[B1-series worker droid|Accutronic B1s]].]]
{{Quote|Nuna-ball isn't all about seeing a noisy rodent punted 60 meters. Internal research tells us that seeing droids get their heads ripped off is equally popular. Combine that with the glamour of droid-show models and over-sized snacks and you've got a family outing that's hard to beat.|[[Lysko Buelia]]|<ref name="HNNV53150">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|sports/1344_1.html|Nuna-Ball League Looks to Expand}}</ref>}}
'''Nuna-ball''' was a sport popular throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was played only by [[Droid/Legends|droids]], a fact that displeased the [[Biological Athletes Union]].<ref name="HNNV53150" />

==Rules==
When angered, a nuna would inflate itself to look bigger. The nuna was then carried in this state by opposing teams toward their opponent's goal.<ref name="HNNV53150" /> When a game was won, the announcer would shout ''Nuuunnnnnnaaaaa!''.<ref name="TNEGTD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

==History==
The game originated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], where [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] would use a live [[Nuna/Legends|nuna]] as a ball. The sport gained popularity after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], where [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturing companies used nuna-ball matches between droid teams as product benchmark stress-tests. At first, these matches were only broadcast in ''[[Consumer Automata]]'' [[Holomag/Legends|holomags]], but by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the games' [[Sports Signal]] coverage had been upgraded from [[HSES6]] to [[HSES4]]. The [[Committee Against Non-Sentient Abuse]], an organization that protested the mishandling of animals, raised its voice against Nuna-ball matches for their misuse of nunas.<ref name="HNNV53150" />

Entire leagues were founded on the basis of this sport, and specialized droid teams could be found among the participants. The sport became the most profitable sport in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history, given the low costs involved in fielding and maintaining the droid players, and the added advertising and promotional value. This made the [[Nuna-Ball League]] very attractive to major droid manufacturers such as [[Trang Robotics]], [[LesTech|Les Tech]], and [[Holowan Mechanicals/Legends|Holowan Mechanicals]]. These offers caused the league to look into expanding from 16 to 32 teams. [[Lysko Buelia]] was a NBL commissioner and former holomag mogul who worked to promote the sport around this time, having been active in its organization from the beginning.<ref name="HNNV53150" /> Another notable personality affiliated with the sport, was the nuna-ball announcer [[Horassa Hunanga]].<ref name="TNEGTD" />

Nuna-ball matches were popular enough to even be watched in sports bars on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>
By [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the sport was still active, with matches being played in the [[Rori Stadium]] on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]].<ref name="COTFSWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|cardname=Nuna-Ball Advertisement|swglink=Nuna ball advertisement.png}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
A game of nuna-ball was glimpsed on one of the [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreens]] in the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]], where a team of [[Otoga-222 maintenance droid/Legends|Otoga-222 maintenance droids]] were competing against a team of modified [[RIC-series general labor droid/Legends|RIC-series droids]]. It is played, generally the same way gridiron football is played, with looser body contact rules.
